After Granger is poisoned by the mole and Eric is one of the seven suspects, Hetty orders a lockdown while everyone is investigated.
Sam reflects on his own upbringing and relationship with his father when the team investigates the murders of marines who have sons in military academies.
As the team investigates a burglary at a cybersecurity company, Hetty reveals that Callen's girlfriend is a lead witness; members of the team discuss their holiday plans.
The undercover investigation of an arms dealer is interrupted when terrorists take over the suspect's office building and Callen is taken hostage.
A freak weather system turns its deadly fury on New York City, unleashing a Sharknado on the population and its most cherished, iconic sites - and only Fin and April can save the Big Apple.
An undercover British journalist risks her life by infiltrating militant extremist groups online.

When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable.

Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.

While vacationing at a remote cabin in the woods, a young girl and her parents are taken hostage by four armed strangers who demand they make an unthinkable choice to avert the apocalypse. Confused, scared and with limited access to the outside world, the family must decide what they believe before all is lost.

Everything that farmer Graham Hess (Mel Gibson) assumed about the world is changed when he discovers a message - an intricate pattern of circles and lines - carved into his crops. As he investigates the unfolding mystery, what he finds will forever alter the lives of his brother (Joaquin Phoenix) and children (Rory Culkin), (Abigail Breslin). A unique story that explores the mysterious real-life phenomena of crop signs and the effects they have on one man and his family.

p.t: Jeanne Dielman, 23 Quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
p.d: Jeanne Dielman (Delphine Seyrig), the widowed mother of a teenage son, Sylvain (Jan Decorte), ekes out a drab, repetitive existence in her tiny Brussels apartment. Jeanne's days are divided between humdrum domestic chores -- shopping, cooking, housework -- and her job as an occasional prostitute, which keeps her financially afloat. She seems perfectly resigned to her situation until a series of slight interruptions in her routine leads to unexpected and dramatic changes.
An opera star (Greta Garbo) kept by an older man (Lewis Stone) falls in love with a preacher (Gavin Gordon) from a rich American family.

In Paris during World War II, Dutch exotic dancer Mata Hari (Greta Garbo) secretly moonlights as a German spy. Using her feminine wiles to seduce French and Russian agents into bed so she can uncover top-secret information, Mata Hari is a primary target of the French Spy Bureau's Dubois (C. Henry Gordon). When Mata Hari falls in love with one of her intended targets, the dashing Lt. Rosanoff (Ramon Novarro), Dubois uses her former accomplice (Lionel Barrymore) to bring her down.

p.t: Susan Lenox: Her Fall and Rise
p.d: A farmer's daughter (Greta Garbo) knows other men as a woman of the world, yet searches for the man (Clark Gable) she loves.

This 19th-century period piece is an adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's classic novel. On a trip to St. Petersburg, Anna Karenina (Greta Garbo), neglected wife of the famed Alexei Alexandrovich Karenin (Basil Rathbone), meets a handsome military officer, Count Vronsky (Freddie Bartholomew). Vronsky becomes enamored of Anna and follows her back to Moscow to confess his feelings. Will she follow her heart to be with him, even if it destroys her family and results in public disgrace?

In this historical drama, the home of Countess Marie Walewska is briefly overrun with Russian Cossacks before fleeing the oncoming Polish forces. When it is discovered that Napoleon Bonaparte is smitten with her from a prior encounter, Marie journeys to a meeting with the emperor to implore him to save Poland from further Russian aggression. Though it would mean the ruin of her marriage and reputation, she is tempted to give in to his amorous advances.

A no-nonsense diplomat of the Soviet Union, Nina Ivanovna Ninotchka Yakushova (Greta Garbo) arrives in Paris to ensure the sale of jewels seized during the Russian Revolution. Meanwhile, carefree bachelor Count Leon d'Algout (Melvyn Douglas) attempts to intercept the valuables on behalf of their former owner, the Grand Duchess Swana (Ina Claire). Despite their conflicting allegiances, the icy Ninotchka soon warms to Leon's charms, reluctantly going against her better judgment.

Idaho ski instructor Karin (Greta Garbo) marries vacationing New York City magazine editor Larry (Melvyn Douglas), convincing him to leave his hectic life behind. When Larry decides to return to the Big Apple for a few days, however, she refuses to accompany him. But Larry doesn't return when expected, so Karin secretly travels to New York City, where she catches him flirting with an old flame. Jealous, she intervenes, posing as her twin sister, Katherine, in an attempt to keep him faithful.

p.t: Beyond The Border: Latino Representation In Hollywood

p.d: A second-generation Mexican immigrant narrates his family history, beginning with the journey of his father, Jose (Jacob Vargas), across Mexico to Los Angeles where he meets Maria (Jennifer Lopez) and starts a family. Each subsequent generation contends with political and social hardships, ranging from illegal deportations in the 1940s to racial tensions and gang fights in the '60s and '70s. Yet through it all, or perhaps because of it, the family remains strong.

Se encuentra dinero de un cártel escondido en un camión. Un menor ebrio requiere tratamiento médico. Un hombre intenta entrar a los EE. UU. con una visa falsa. Dos hermanas intentan pasar medicamentos. Se halla cocaína en bolsas de basura.
Ladrón dispara al jefe de policía en Virginia. Robo a mano armada y persecución de autos en Nuevo México.

Una pasajera revela el verdadero motivo de su viaje. Además, agentes encuentran más irregularidades de las esperadas en el equipaje de una pareja. Por su parte, un objeto aparentemente común suscita dudas entre los viajeros que regresan de EE. UU.

Un despiadado encuentro donde los supervivientes luchan contra el agotamiento y la naturaleza.
Amy Bruni y Adam Berry investigan la existencia de una entidad salvaje que acecha en la escuela Farrar, ubicada en Maxwell, Iowa.

Gary y Karra intentan sobrevivir en la desolada sabana de Brasil, pero se les acaban los alimentos y los gusanos les hacen pasar un suplicio. Uno de ellos, muerto de hambre, enferma cuando come lo que no debe.
Tras una vida de abusos y humillaciones, Michael tiene ansiedad y miedo de salir de su casa. Ahora, con la ayuda de su esposa, debe seguir el programa del Dr. Now para evitar comer hasta morir.

Dejados en las alturas de la jungla de Colombia, Tommy y Leah se enfrentan a pumas territoriales y serpientes venenosas, pero la mayor amenaza son los cambios extremos de temperatura, que van desde los 40 grados Celsius hasta los 4 grados de noche.
Los concursantes se adentran en una selva colombiana embrujada, poblada por jaguares mortíferos, trescientas especies distintas de serpientes e insectos que atormentarán su estadía en la jungla.

Los tornados se encuentran entre los fenómenos naturales más destructivos del mundo, y EE. UU. concentra la mayor cantidad a nivel global. Expertos explican cómo se forman, mientras habitantes de Kentucky y Misuri comparten historias de supervivencia.

Dos de los tsunamis más mortales jamás registrados son el del océano Índico de 2004 y el de Tohoku en Japón en 2011. Los sobrevivientes relatan experiencias traumáticas mientras científicos revelan sus causas y señales de alerta.

Los incendios forestales se están convirtiendo en megaincendios que devastan zonas pobladas y causan trágicas pérdidas de vidas, como ocurrió con el incendio de Yarnell Hill y el de Maui en Lahaina, Hawái. Los expertos investigan la ciencia y las causas.

Teresa, el Zurdo y sus hombres son recibidos por Abdelkader en Marruecos. Les da la bienvenida con alfombra roja y una fiesta suntuosa en su palacio. Los tres cierran un negocio millonario.
La cena está servida, Teresa asiste a su cita con Lupo y su familia. Vita, una prostituta, se hace pasar por su esposa. El Zurdo la sigue hasta el restaurante e interrumpe la velada.
Alegnis se arrepintió después de haberse sometido a 10 cirugías estéticas para convertirse en la copia de la exesposa de su marido. Carolina causó un accidente mortal con una patineta.
Tras un accidente, mantienen intimidad como pueden, pero ella ya no aguanta más. Una congregación incita a sus fieles a tener sexo con la naturaleza y Celeste exige que le devuelvan el diezmo.
Cree que su esposa quiere que regrese solo por una herencia, ella pide que se haga un bypass gástrico. La madre exige custodia total de su hija, el papá es pastor de la iglesia de la marihuana.
La niña muere por el agua alojada en sus pulmones, su madre culpa al papá. Marina queda muda cuando su hijastra le empuja la cara contra el pastel y se perfora las cuerdas vocales.
Toda la familia está a la espera de la decisión de Said, pero es Jade quien tiene la última palabra. Daniel le pone un ultimátum a Albieri, Luisa encuentra una nota que lo compromete.
Daniel hace algo que Lucas no hizo por Jade, ella reconoce la diferencia. Comienza el juicio por la paternidad de Daniel con el testimonio de Leonardo. Alejandro recibe noticias de Natalia.
El juicio es una nueva oportunidad para que Lucas y Daniel se enfrenten por Jade. En la audiencia, llega el turno de Dora para dar su testimonio. Alejandro quiere olvidar a Natalia.
Daniel le exige al senador que diga la verdad, él prefiere otra salida. El Diablo teme que la policía tenga la prueba de la extorsión. Lucía se reúne con Ponce en el hospital y llega Rafael.
Liliana asesina a Enrique Vidal y López escapa aterrado, los busca la policía tras una confesión, Rafael le grita a Lucía y le impide salir de la casa. Ponce es encarcelado y hace una petición.
El olfato es clave para reconocer hierbas aromáticas en la prueba de salvación. Entre dimes y diretes, la eliminación llega con un guiso que deja la competencia reducida a 10 participantes.
Su padre la expulsa y Circe se muda con Joselito, y él le recuerda que si no fuera por él, el capo la hubiera matado; así que recibe una recompensa, luego de que él tratara de sobrepasarse.
Cada segundo que Amanda pasa con su padre está en peligro. Isabel empieza a trabajar como bailarina en un cabaret para conseguir dinero y pagar un buen abogado. Diego desea ayudar a Isabel.
Gran celebración en la casa del mafioso Rosellini. Los principales capos brindan por el negocio con Teresa. Hay un desconocido que espera a la mexicana para dejarla sin escapatoria.

p.d: Karen Mills was a county court judge and criminal defense attorney in Florida before turning to TV to preside over her own court shows. In her third effort, "Supreme Justice," Mills tackles small-claims court arbitrations in her compassionate way, to which viewers of her previous shows have grown accustomed. As usual with court shows, cases involve friendships gone bad, money disputes and property damage.

Judge Mablean Ephriam, who presided over "Divorce Court" from 1999-2006 as the first star of the revived version of the show, returns to the courtroom genre with his half-hour series that deals with life and the law. The former Los Angeles-based prosecutor takes on the typical cases that are found on TV court shows. The arbitrator says that her show "will be life because everything we do, it involves the law."

War breaks out between the Willises and the Jeffersons, with Lionel and Jenny as the first casualties.
George adds fuel to the fire by setting Lionel up with another girl.
A life-and-death situation grips the Jefferson household.
When George forgets Mother Jefferson's birthday, Louise saves the day.

Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence.

As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict.

In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the 🏁 [NASCAR] Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes).

Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life.

The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless.

New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

Danyael is the offspring of an angel and a mortal woman. After being gunned down in a seemingly fatal shooting, he rises from the dead and realizes he possesses great powers. The evil angels Pyriel and Zophael then set out to convince Danyael to do their bidding and help wreak havoc on the planet. But former angel Gabriel, who was cast down to earth in human form, tries to sway Danyael toward the path of righteousness.

A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions.

After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca, haggard and unrecognizable. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. His beloved wife, Penelope, is a prisoner in her own home and hounded to choose a new husband. Their son faces death at the hands of suitors who see him as an obstacle in their pursuit of Penelope and the kingdom. Odysseus is no longer the mighty warrior his people remember, but he must face his past to save his family.

In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom.

Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart.

An accident connects four groups of people on three different continents: two young Moroccan goatherds, a vacationing American couple (Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett), a deaf Japanese teen and her father, and a Mexican nanny who takes her young charges across a border without parental permission.
A paradise beach in the Bahamas is transformed as the ocean simply vanishes; a woman films the silhouette of a 12-foot monster lurking in the fog.

p.t: Todo en 90 días: casados en el extranjero
p.d: Luke avergüenza a Madelein frente a su organizador de bodas. Greta y Matthew comparten una reunión incómoda en el Reino Unido. Manon confronta a sus padres sobre su infancia. La familia extendida de Sumit desaprueba a Jenny.

p.t: Todo en 90 días: casados en el extranjero
p.d: Madelein estalla cuando Luke le confiesa lo de su despedida de soltero. Greta se siente desconectada de Matthew. Sumit consuela a Jenny por la pelea con su tía. Pattiya planea mudarse a Australia para estar con Dylan.

p.t: Todo en 90 días: diarios en pandemia
p.d: Kalani y Asuelu enfrentan problemas maritales mientras intentan mudarse de Utah. Ron les ofrece a Brandon y Julia una gran solución a los problemas de su pequeño apartamento. Cortney tiene una primera cita incómoda en un safari de animales.
Mary lleva a su hija menor a Nueva York y Rebecca reacciona mal. Abe se pregunta si el costo de su trabajo dental tiene sentido.
Karen y Barry frían el desayuno en el motor del coche y se sacan sus propios dientes en casa para evitar gastar dinero.
La muy esperada boda de dos novios gitanos, a pesar de la desaprobación de sus madres; una mamá gitana ex convicta trata de poner su pasado detrás.

Los Johnston se dirigen a Austin para asistir a la conferencia de la LPA. La familia organiza un taller, Alex se reencuentra con Allie, y Trent y Amber compiten en el concurso de talentos. Liz y Brice tienen una noticia que compartir con sus padres.

Los Busby aplican disciplina para controlar los terribles dos años; Danielle presiona a Adam para que responda sobre cómo se siente; con Mimi tomando su tiempo para mudarse a su nueva casa, Danielle planea ayudarla para enfrentar su nueva vida.

El procedimiento médico de Matt les deja a él y a Caryn pensando en su futuro juntos. Amy y Chris hacen planes para la próxima recaudación de fondos y para celebrar el comienzo del verano, Zach y Jackson planean una acampada familiar.

p.t: Todo en 90 días: Antes del viaje
p.d: Gino cuestiona la fidelidad de Jasmine. Riley descubre a Violet mandando mensajes a otro hombre. Statler está ansiosa por conocer a su novia Dempsey. A Cleo le preocupa que Christian dude. ¿David y Sheila llegan hasta el final?

p.t: Todo en 90 días: Antes del viaje
p.d: Gino enfrenta a Jasmine sobre su relación secreta. Meisha y Nicola descubren cosas sorprendentes en una cita. Tyray contrata a un investigador privado. Riley pone a Violet en la mira. Christian y Cleo tienen ideas diferentes sobre la diversión.

La mejor información de deportiva de Panamá y el mundo.

Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Drew Barrymore, quien co-protagonizó la película "Los ángeles de Charlie", es la productora ejecutiva de la serie.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.

Un teniente de policía se debate entre la fidelidad al cuerpo y la vinculación que mantiene con los amigos junto a los que creció en las calles más duras de Los Ángeles, para quienes, a menudo, la policía es el enemigo.
Los accidentes catastróficos en la historia de la aviación son reproducidos meticulosamente para determinar si estos desastres pudieron haber sido prevenidos.

After a female presidential candidate, Valerie Caldwell, is targeted with a car bomb, OA and Maggie must find them before they strike again; the case leads them to wonder if she is being targeted for her political aspirations or something else.

After a shooting at a nightclub, it appears that the FBI may have ignored previous threats from a local white supremacist group; Kristen wrestles with her commitment to the bureau and her responsibility to her community.

The team hunts a killer who is fatally shooting seemingly unrelated targets; new agent Tiffany Wallace experiences tension between her work as an FBI agent and the responsibility she feels to her community as a Black woman.

After a bomb leaves three people dead, the team presses a reluctant informant to gather information from his close friends who are under suspicion; OA and his girlfriend clash over where the informant's rights lie.

When a reporter is kidnapped and held without a ransom demand, the team must dig into her past relationships in order to pin down her assailant's motive; Isobel's relationship comes under fire when the case makes a connection to her boyfriend.
The team must track down two assailants who wear animal masks while committing armed robberies; Tiffany and Scola butt heads on whether to accept the local NYPD's offer to help in the investigation.
After a man is killed by an explosive package shipped to his home, the team attempts to capture the sender and intercept his latest deadly parcel; Maggie struggles to trust her younger sister.

The team rushes to track down two doctors abducted by a desperate father willing to do anything to save his son; Jubal's uncertainty in his family life affects his judgment during the hostage situation.

When the CEO of a major brokerage firm is killed while surrounded by protesters, the team looks into who had the most to lose from his company's perceived manipulations; Scola's previous Wall Street career and the reasons he left come to light.

While investigating a mass casualty incident at a New York City restaurant, the team scrambles to determine if it was racially motivated and if there was more than one gunman; Maggie starts to notice troubling behavior from her co-worker Elise.

When five prominent men are gunned down at a trendy New York restaurant, the team's investigation brings them into contact with a lieutenant in Antonio Vargas' cartel, triggering a showdown between Isobel and Vargas.
After a young woman is killed on her way home from a lavish yacht party, the team investigates who she was and how she came to be at the event.

A young Bruce Wayne travels to the Far East, where he's trained in the martial arts by Henri Ducard, a member of the mysterious League of Shadows. When Ducard reveals the League's true purpose -- the complete destruction of Gotham City -- Wayne returns to Gotham intent on cleaning up the city without resorting to murder. With the help of Alfred, his loyal butler, and Lucius Fox, a tech expert at Wayne Enterprises, Batman is born.

With the help of allies, Lt. Jim Gordon and DA Harvey Dent, Batman is able to keep a tight lid on crime in Gotham City. But when a young criminal calling himself the Joker suddenly throws the town into chaos, the caped crusader begins to tread a fine line between heroism and vigilantism.

Erwin es una chica genio de 12 años, nada popular, pero es mucho más inteligente que sus compañeros de clase. Determinada a ganar el concurso de ciencia, ella hace equipo con otros marginados para inventar un químico que altere la jerarquía social.
Las celebridades de Hollywood dan cuenta de su vida personal y profesional, y se sinceran sobre sus próximos proyectos.

Mientras un viejo enemigo planea destruirlo, el Hombre de Acero intenta regresar con Lois Lane y encuentra su lugar en un mundo que ha aprendido a vivir con su ausencia.

Historia de un futuro ficticio donde Inglaterra es un estado fascista y totalitario. Evey, una joven proveniente de la clase trabajadora, es rescatada por "V", un misterioso enmascarado que busca la destrucción del gobierno cruel y corrupto.
Un agente lucha con rufianes que tienen tomado Alcatraz para obtener la ubicación de la fortuna en oro de un convicto.

Jack se ve envuelto en una dura pelea durante una fiesta, donde es vencido y humillado. Avergonzado, decide aprender artes marciales de la mano de un mentor, quien le enseñará disciplina y las claves para llegar a lo más alto.

Tyne y su tripulación salen a alta mar esperando poder recuperarse de la mala racha que están teniendo. Para ello, y a pesar de los partes meteorológicos, el capitán convence a sus hombres para adentrarse más en el Atlántico. No conocen la magnitud de la tormenta que les aguarda.
Los amigos de Luis intentan evitar que se case con su odiosa prometida. Ellos saben que ella le fue infiel hace dos días, pero necesitan demostrárselo con pruebas para que la ceremonia no se celebre.

While Lex Luthor plots to destroy him once and for all, the Man of Steel returns after a long absence to a much-changed world. Lois Lane has moved on with her life, and society has learned to survive without him. Superman must find a way to reconnect with her and find his place in a world that may no longer need him.

Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

Criminal mastermind Donny/49er One (Morris Chestnut) has set in motion a plan to infiltrate a high-tech prison in order to persuade a death row inmate to reveal the whereabouts of $200 million worth of gold. Undercover FBI agent Sascha (Steven Seagal) must stop him before it's too late.

Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou).

Based on a true story, the film tells of the courageous men and women who risk their lives every working day, pitting their fishing boats and rescue vessels against the capricious forces of nature. Their worst fears are realized at sea on Halloween of 1991, when they are confronted by three raging weather fronts which unexpectedly collide to produce the greatest, fiercest storm in modern history -- "The Perfect Storm."

Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves to Southern California with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), but quickly finds himself the target of a group of bullies who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate and preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

A round-up of the day's news.
GB Paralympian Darren Silverstone stole the hearts of a nation before his infamous choke in Tokyo. For the first time, he tells his story and starts his glorious sporting comeback.

p.t: Back to the Future Part II
p.d: Time-travel sequel with Marty McFly and the eccentric inventor Doc Brown travelling back and forth in time to stop their nemesis tampering with history. By stealing the time machine and travelling back in time himself, Biff Tannen gives his younger self a book containing fifty years of sports statistics which he uses to amass an enormous gambling fortune and power.
Selwyn's return to Saint Marie is disrupted by a dramatic death at his offices, where a man has fallen from the roof. Meanwhile, a new family connection arrives in Mervin's life.

Continuing her journey through mankind's journey, Cunk visits the allegedly beautiful city of Florence to explore the Renaissance, and she interrogates experts and historians about the revolutions that went on to shape the modern world, including the American War of Independence, and to a lesser extent, the French Revolution.

Cunk continues her ambitious march across the face of mankind into an age of industry and science. With the help of historians, and a science-historian, she explains the scientific breakthroughs of Marie Curie and Albert Einstein. She demonstrates the inventions that changed the world, and covers how the US Civil War, World War I and World War II taught humanity how to use its new grasp of technology to shoot, blow up and irradiate itself in huge numbers.

Cunk travels the world and meets top experts to examine the Cold War, the Space Race, Globalisation and Social Media. Recent history is one of polarisation and division as humanity divided itself down the middle: Communism vs Capitalism, Apple vs Microsoft, Beatles vs Stones.
Moz plots to win back the heart of his true love, Jenny. However, when he discovers she has joined the police force, his plans are thrown into disarray.
A penniless Moz calls in his debts. However, his mates seem very reluctant to pay him back. Elsewhere, Jess falls under the spell of masked hit man Cartoon Head.
Moz and Nicki start running rival hash dealing businesses, but a price war soon kicks off with each attempting to undercut the other. Across the landing, Brian and Carmel have opened a brothel.

Mistakenly believing Moz to be an avant-garde artist, Tilly arranges for him to have an exhibition. Meanwhile, Jess and Cartoon Head experiment with ketamine and find themselves way out of their depth.
Moz tries to turn his friendship with Tilly into a full-blown relationship, and Colin hires his estranged wife Carmel as an escort girl.
Moz comes face to face with a gang of deadly gingers known as the Red Mist, Carmel has to choose between Colin and Jake, whilst Yasuko leaves Derrick for Fist.
A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.
The Shadow Foreign Secretary talks to Nick Robinson about Trump's diplomacy, the withdrawal from Afghanistan and being sanctioned by China.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
The game show that mixes general knowledge quizzing and bowling.
Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

Armed with his interwar copy of Bradshaw's Guide to the Railways, Michael reaches the Kent seaside resort of Herne Bay, where he learns about a pioneering aviatrix who began her working life as a typist in Hull but whose epic achievements made her an international celebrity. Michael takes the train five miles west along the coast before heading offshore into the entrance to the Thames Estuary.

Mexico City is one of the world's emerging food destinations, and it's also Eva Longoria's second home. Longoria takes us to some of her favourite eating spots, but in this constantly evolving city, there is always more to explore.

China's heartland is the centre of a 5,000-year-old civilisation and is home to the giant panda, the golden snub-nosed monkey and the golden takin. China faces environmental problems, but the relationship the Chinese have with their environment is deep and extraordinary. We will understand what this means for the future of China.

Paul Martin presents from Muncaster Castle in Cumbria, where hundreds of people turn up with collectibles and treasures they want to take to auction. Antiques experts Adam Partridge and Caroline Hawley uncover a few gems including a silver candlestick and some Coalbrookedale plates, and Paul delves into the Lake District's bobbin industry.

Larry Dean, Kirsty Gallagher, Sam Quek and Lemn Sissay take on a series of quiz rounds selected by Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

Clive heads for the east coast of Barbados to check out the world's oldest rum distillery. He explores the sugar cane fields and the factory floor before he gets the chance to have a sip of the golden produce.
Insights and global interviews on the crucial news stories of the day. With Matt Chorley.

Brian Cunningham looks at which trees can be planted that will cope with wet conditions, and Carole Baxter is back with another one of her visits to a great Scottish garden.
In a special programme exploring the enduring value of allotment life, Frances Tophill heads to Exmouth in Devon, where thriving plots and passionate growers are at the heart of a vibrant community.

Melinda Messenger and Lee Ryan face off against each other and compete to win money for charity, with a little help from their families.

p.d: In Glastonbury, Simon O'Brien makes a Flintstones style table out of antique roof tiles, while Henry Cole fashions a quirky lamp out of traffic lights.

Michael and Alex are given six months to transform a tired old house in Liverpool into a modern family home. But major damp issues, a giant hole in the living room floor and a full rewire are just some of the problems they have to deal with.

It's been a week of divisive digs and bothersome DIY breakfasts. What better way to sort it all out than with a good old-fashioned sit-down on payment day?

After Karambha fails to arrive at Asur Lok, Diti becomes concerned. Parvati gives a last warning to Karambha, but he seeks a battle.

Weihnachten steht vor der Tür und die Baxters intensivieren ihre Gotteshausbesuche. Da treffen sie in der Kirche auf Ryan, den Vater von Kristins Sohn Boyd. Damals hat Ryan die beiden nach der Geburt sitzen gelassen. Mike kann seinen Zorn nur schwer bändigen. Und Kristins neuer Freund Kyle fürchtet, sie an ihren Ex zu verlieren.

Die Jungs müssen auf Jamie passen, während Hal Windeln kaufen geht. Doch dann sind da drei Mädels, die mit ihnen ausgehen möchten. Malcolm und Reese merken, dass sie nur von ihnen ausgenutzt werden. Dewey bleibt unterdessen bei Jamie.

Abe will Stevie informieren über Kittys Trennung, doch Rees ist ihm zuvor. Stevie ist so traurig, dass er nur noch durch einen Sprachcomputer mit seiner Umwelt kommuniziert. Um ihn aufzuheitern, nimmt Malcolm an einem Rollstuhl-Turnier teil.
Jay wurde von seinem Körper getrennt. In seinem geisterhaften Zustand kann er zum ersten Mal die Geister sehen - und heimlich seine Eltern belauschen. Pete besucht Jay in Sams Körper.
Bastian verkündet in der Sendung Stadtgespräch beim Kölner Lokalsender Center.TV, dass er sich vorstellen könnte, auch mal einen Kölner Tatort-Kommissar zu spielen.
Zu Gast ist der Super-Bowl-Quarterback, Autor und Bürgerrechtsaktivist Colin Kaepernick.

Stan will endlich seinen "gestriegelten Bastard"-Nachbarn Chuck White bei der allsonntäglichen Fahrt zur Kirche besiegen und schneller ankommen. Doch es gelingt nicht. Und noch schlimmer: Der Diakon erklärt in seiner Messe, dass die White-Tochter Betsy für die USA als Turnerin zu den Olympischen Spielen fahren wird.

Stans Wunsch nach einer Beförderung gelangt in greifbare Nähe, als Hayley auf seinen Boss Bullock trifft. Nach einer heftigen Konversation über Politik scheinen sich die beiden ganz gut zu verstehen. Doch bis zur möglichen Beförderung stehen für Stan noch einige Hürden an, die es zu managen gilt.

Fry und Bender begeben sich in die Roboterhölle, um die Seele des Roboterschauspielers Calculon zu entführen, um ihm eine zweite Chance auf Ruhm zu geben. Calculon kehrt zurück, indem er eine Sicherheitskopie von sich selbst herunterlädt.

Benders Körperteile werden geraubt. Ihm bleiben nur noch seine Augen und sein Mund übrig. Seine Teile werden von Dieben im ganzen Universum verkauft. Mithilfe einer Hehlerliste sammeln Benders Freunde die Teile wieder ein. Nur das Hinterteil fehlt.

Die Kinder haben Angst, von einem grimmigen Weihnachtsmann auf die Liste der ungezogenen Kinder gesetzt zu werden. Deshalb geben Gene, Tina und Louise eine musikalische Revue, in der sie alle guten Taten des letzten Jahres vorführen.
Bob veranstaltet eine Dinnerparty, was Gayle nutzt, um ihren neuen Freund der Familie vorzustellen.
Als Craig und Tweek als schwul geoutet werden, sind sie genauso überrascht wie alle anderen.
Nur ein Neustart der Nationalhymne kann Amerika noch retten. Randy ist politisch frustriert.
Francine erlangt Aufmerksamkeit, als ein berühmter Kunsthändler ihre Töpferarbeiten entdeckt.
Charlie persuades a reluctant Caroline to let Joanna babysit, but a drama with the kitchen sink gets her into hot water.
Ray is disturbed to learn that the boys are playing fairies in the school play, especially when he discovers that they chose their roles.
Robert gets a surprise visit from the gorgeous Stefania, who he fell for in Rome, and her father. The reality of their relationship may match the holiday romance.
Marie and Debra have a housekeeping war after Ray buys a cutting-edge vacuum cleaner from an attractive saleswoman.
Tempers flare when Marie accuses Debra of not returning a borrowed canister that holds sentimental value and Debra insists that she has already given it back.
Sabrina's sloppy spell casting turns Harvey into his childhood superhero idol, while Kraft quits school to become a world-famous aviator.
Sabrina receives a Valentine's card from a secret admirer, but she must find out who the mystery man is before he steals her heart forever.
Duke, an old crony of Salem's and former con man, has finished his sentence as a cat and is ready to go straight, but his commitment soon starts to waver.
Salem is heartbroken to receive a wedding announcement from his estranged daughter Annabelle, who hasn't spoken to him in decades.
Joe, Murr, Sal and Q skirt the law while posing as receptionists, then go fishing for people's luggage at a mall. This week's loser has a tough sell on their hands.
The guys compete head-to-head selling their toys to focus groups, team up attaching clothes pegs to unsuspecting shoppers, and play a game of touching laser pointer dots.

Monica and Chandler discover that their prospective adoptive child's biological father may be a 'shovel killer', Ross and Rachel get dangerously close when they go to visit her sick father, and Phoebe struggles to teach Joey French for an audition.

Rachel makes the mistake of going for a job interview at a restaurant where her current boss is also dining. Phoebe discovers she can change her name to whatever she likes - Princess Consuela Bananahammock seems the logical choice, until Mike proves that two can play her game - and Joey, upset that Chandler and Monica are moving, is comforted by an eight-year-old.

When Rachel makes a startling announcement, Ross secretly schemes to get her former job back for her. Meanwhile, Joey is so flustered by all the upheaval in his friends' lives that Phoebe prevents him from learning about the sudden death of his agent. Monica and Chandler make a stunning discovery after they check out the house for sale next door to their new home.

As Rachel prepares to leave for Paris, the gang throw a farewell party for her. Instead of facing them all together, she takes each of them aside for a private goodbye. One friend is offended when he is excluded. Meanwhile, Monica barks out orders as she packs precisely for her life in the suburbs with Chandler, and they watch closely the pregnant mother of their future adopted child.

p.t: Whose Line Is It Anyway? USA
p.d: Aisha Tyler hosts this skit comedy show where the actors on the show, usually Wayne Brady, Colin Mochrie, Ryan Stiles and another guest star or two do different comedy skits. It's all improv and made up on the spot.
Mike has trouble dealing with the fact that his childhood friend Nate has more in common with Carter than meets the eye.
Mike overhears Nikki discussing her boyfriend without realising that she has created a fictitious character based on him.
After weeks of procrastinating, Rachel finally takes down the Christmas lights, but sprains her ankle.
Someone is pretending to be Monica, using her credit card numbers and having the sort of fun that Monica wishes she could have.
Monica discovers that she's developed a highly mature approach to her latest love affair, and Ross finds out that he's being mistaken for a male prostitute.

Ross has been in love with Rachel since ninth grade but has always kept it a secret. Now the truth accidentally comes out, but as Rachel rushes to the airport to greet Ross on his return from a business trip, she discovers that work is not all he's been getting up to while he's been away.
Features crimes against fashion, crimes against florists, and crimes committed by canines!
Lawless laughs featuring neighbourly disputes, car crime, and OAP outlaws.
The guys compete in a four-way job-exchanging challenge, and then record people's conversations for strange reasons.
The guys, posing as waiters, offer ridiculous specials to customers, and team up at a house-keeping job, doing and saying whatever the other guys tell them.
A flabbergasted Rays feels violated after he learns that his mother read his private diary when he was little.
After spending Valentine's dinner without talking to each other, Ray and Debra agree to take an interest in each other's hobbies - she into basketball and he into reading.
Ray is disturbed to learn that the boys are playing fairies in the school play, especially when he discovers that they chose their roles.
Robert gets a surprise visit from the gorgeous Stefania, who he fell for in Rome, and her father. The reality of their relationship may match the holiday romance.

It's the annual Shootout powerboat race weekend on the Lake of the Ozarks, and the action's not just on the water - with officers rounding up unruly revellers in the bars and confiscating meth and psychedelic mushrooms from cars on the motorway.
A man takes an alligator grocery shopping; an alleged thief tries a strange tactic to mask his identity; a runaway suspect finds an unusually tight hiding place.
A road rage suspect attacks a bailiff in court; a grieving mother screams at the hit-and-run driver who killed her daughter; a jury bungles the sentencing phase of a murder trial.

p.t: Murder at My Door with Kym Marsh
p.d: The story of 17-year-old Thomas Griffiths, who killed his girlfriend and arranged the crime scene to look like a suicide after she broke up with him.

p.t: Murder at My Door with Kym Marsh
p.d: The story of a teen named Margaret, who vanished while in the care of her father's family friends following his death.

p.t: Murder at My Door with Kym Marsh
p.d: Susan Annis was a dedicated nurse, but tragedy struck when she fell into a coma in her room after inviting Kevin Cobb, another nurse she'd met and befriended, in for a drink.

When a woman drowns in her tub, police think a recent purported suicide attempt holds the answer. But two years later when her husband confesses to the murder of his second wife, the cause of the first wife's death comes into question.

When a housewife dies in her hot tub, detectives in a normally quiet Idaho town first believe it to be a horrible accident. But the investigation leads back to the unsolved murder of her husband, reminding police that lightning never strikes twice.
A couple's pickup is found submerged in a lake, and the wife's death appears to be the result of a horrible accident until investigators learn that not everything is as it seems in this pair's union.
A man is found in a west Los Angeles alley, dead from an apparent hit and run. When investigators dig deeper, strange suspects emerge in a twisted tale of greed.
The body of Elsie Jennes is found in the basement of her burning house.
A young father loses his life when tempers flare and bullets fly at a Gwinnett County nightclub.

A defendant shows up for his bond violation hearing holding his infant son; the judge blasts a woman convicted of Operating a Vehicle With a Restricted or Controlled Substance for lack of accountability.

A woman accused of Domestic Violence and Assault with a Dangerous Weapon violates a protection order by travelling to the courthouse with her alleged victim; the judge must temporarily continue a defendant's bond.
Officers pull over a businessman from Mexico who is making a rare journey to the US in a brand-new car and a pedestrian gets more than he bargains for when he is mistaken for a wanted man.
Rick Stein visits the city of Thessaloniki revered as the gourmet capital of Greece and birthplace to possibly the greatest warrior general that ever lived, Alexander the Great.

Rick Stein visits the fascinating city of Palermo in northern Sicily. Like a vibrant carpet, the city is patterned with echoes of Arab, North African, French, Spanish and Italian influences, making its cuisine unique and irresistible.

Freddie Flintoff, Chris Harris and Paddy McGuinness head to the British 🏎️ [F1] Grand Prix for a showdown with a trio of F1's finest drivers. Elsewhere, Paddy pays tribute to the legendary Eddie Kidd OBE.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy set out to revolutionise the world of caravanning, with the help of some new electric cars and some very small caravans. Out on track, Chris reviews the extravagant new Lamborghini Huracán STO.

Paul, Bob, and Ted travel to Driffield Beck at Mulberry Whin in East Riding of Yorkshire to catch brown trout. They get started, but are slightly distracted by Ted, who is obsessed with rolling in the mud on the riverbank.

Guy helps the £500,000 restoration of the world's oldest surviving Brixham sailing trawler, the boat that launched the modern fishing industry and transformed the way a nation ate. He experiences deep sea trawling, said to be the most dangerous job of the 19th century, for himself, and discovers how Britain acquired its taste for fish and chips.

There was a time when the British pub was pretty much a male-only establishment and food, at best, was a bowl of nuts and some pork scratchings. Today, most British pubs depend on the income from food and some dishes have become pub classics. Dave and Si explore the history behind the boom in pub food and recreate mouthwatering dishes that would make any publican proud.

Paul and Bob travel with their trusty terrier Ted to fish the mighty river Trent in Nottingham in search of a barbel. In the large, wide river, they can sense the presence of big barbel, but will they land one?
The guests joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Steph McGovern, Richard Osman, Jennifer Saunders and Joe Sugg.
The guests joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Tom Allen, Geoff Norcott, Vicki Pepperdine and Esme Young.
Sandi Toksvig runs the numbers with Colin Lane, Sarah Millican, Noel Fielding, and Alan Davies.
When the Dobermans dig up what appears to be a human bone, Magnum and Higgins help Katsumoto investigate the murder of his former mentor.
With just days left to move logs before fire season shuts them down, it's all hands on deck to save a sinking float camp and cash out at both camps.
In the logging world, big wood equals big money; it's a tough job for the crews logging and transporting the big and valuable timber.

Naturalist builder Cat Taylor builds a remote sanctuary in the piney woods of Northwest Texas; she builds the two-story house using a cob mixture and adds touches of comfort to entertain family members.

Professional tree-house builder Michael 'Murph' Murphy wants to build a cottage retreat for his family in Washington; he enlists his friends to create natural siding and a massive fishing net for lounging above the living space.
An adorable baby hippo arrives, and an orphaned koala needs support. Plus, a team travels to Kenya to share their innovative milk formula for elephant calves.
Florida natives Miranda and Michael have moved to Alaska. Life in the Last Frontier will be nothing like what they left behind in the Sunshine State.

Amanda and Eric are ready to buy their first home in Talkeetna, Alaska. Every penny counts as they recently got married, so they may have to go the extra mile.
Laci and Kane are living in an apartment above their gym in Fairbanks, but they're really looking for the Alaskan experience, out of the city limits and into the wild.

The Raney family turns cameras on themselves as they shelter in place on their Alaskan homestead. When a moose kill is discovered dangerously close to their cabin, Marty attempts to track the predators.
Mike hunts down an early SUV, a 1970 International Harvester Scout 800A. Ant's repair includes rebuilding a leaky transfer case and replacing the interior to restore it to its former glory.
As Jake sets gear in heavy seas, a painful skin infection spreads among the Cornelia Marie crew.

In Birmingham hat es eine Familie versäumt, 4.700 Euro in Kindergartengebühren zu bezahlen. Gerichtsvollzieher Garry Ball und Matt Heighway werden zunächst von den Eltern angeschrien. Trotzdem bemühen sie sich um eine geeignete Lösung.

Andreas entwickelt eine neue Technik, um in einem deutschen Kieswerk nach Gold zu schürfen. Mat ist derweil unterwegs im Outback Australiens, um ebenfalls wertvolles Edelmetall zu finden. Sein Ziel ist es, seinen Geländewagen zurückzubekommen.

Andreas und seine Söhne testen in einem deutschen Kieswerk ihre Dredge. Doch Treibsand macht den Probelauf zu einem tückischen Unterfangen. Währenddessen versorgen Mat und Rhien sich in Australien mit Treibstoff.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Die Saison beginnt denkbar schlecht, denn der Wirtschaftsausschuss des Senats hat einen vorübergehenden Fangstopp verhängt. Die Fangboote dürfen Dutch Harbor nicht verlassen. Dadurch steht die Existenz der Seeleute auf dem Spiel.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Endlich kann die Fangsaison richtig beginnen, der Fangstopp der Regierung wurde aufgehoben. Deckhand Freddy Maugatai zelebriert an Bord der "Wizard" ein Ritual aus Samoa, das Glück bringen soll. Dazu müssen er und die Besatzung Kabeljaublut trinken.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Ein Frachtschiff aus Südamerika legt am Hafen von Ambarlı in Istanbul an. Bei der Kontrolle der Papiere stößt der Zoll auf Unstimmigkeiten. Die Herkunft der Güter ist suspekt.
Zollbeamte entdecken ein ausgeklügeltes Geheimversteck im Fahrerhaus eines Lkws.

Daniel Lieser und Axel Zoor schauen sich in Offenburg eine Harley-Davidson genauer an. In der Ruhrpott-Metropole Bochum möchte ein Kunde derweil sein Mountainbike versilbern. Und in Siegburg steht Nikolaus Bode vor einer Premiere.

Eine unklare Fahrzeughistorie und widersprüchliche Aussagen machen Pam in Nürnberg misstrauisch. Ihr Kollege Norman entdeckt an dem Ford Explorer zudem technische Mängel. Unter diesen Voraussetzungen kommt ein Geschäft kaum infrage.

Ein Interessent möchte das Schatzsucherschiff kaufen. Doch aus dem Schiff wurde Technik geklaut. Zudem ist der georderte Kran zu schwach, um das Schiff aus dem Hafen zu hieven. Kalle und Klotzki befriedigen indes die Nachfrage nach weiteren Humvees.

Nach jahrelanger Arbeit ist es endlich so weit: Die Grumman HU-16 hebt zu einem Probeflug ab. Das Amphibienflugzeug hebt zwar problemlos ab, doch rasch zeigen sich Probleme mit dem Bugrad. Die Crew bereitet eine Notlandung vor.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.
Per Boot erreichen die 14 Überlebenskünstlerinnen und Überlebenskünstler in Südafrika den Startpunkt der Challenge. Dort beginnt das Abenteuer mit einem Einstiegstest, der drei Phasen umfasst.

The Poseidon Crew are desperate to find fine gold to fund their expensive operation. The rookie team of Jacqui and Andrew have some beginners' luck when they find gold nuggets in Queensland.
Brave builders refuse to set limits on their inventive off-the-grid builds. The epic construction results include a sustainable bamboo oasis and an underground retreat.
Looking at how inventive off-the-grid builders have created some of the world's most unique structures, including a redwood retreat, a mushroom getaway, a cliff house escape, a desert dome home.

Sig buries his beloved mother and the last of his family's pioneering generation. Sean Dwyer joins forces with Rick Shelford, but the captains don't see eye to eye on rules. Jacob fights back on the Wizard and finds no safe harbour from Capt Keith.
The treasure hunters make a new discovery, and a run-in with a jaguar leads to another revelation, but the new path has tragic consequences for Captain Keith.

Josh scours Virginia backcountry in search of the legendary Thomas Beale Treasure, worth millions today. With encrypted codes hiding its whereabouts, Josh takes a detour to Philadelphia to uncover missing pieces to the puzzle.

Josh travels to the UK and Norway to unlock the secrets of the Viking Sunstone, a mystic crystal the Vikings used to conquer the seas. Before testing it, he explores a crypt in a Nordic church and descends 1000 ft into a deserted mine.
The Raneys rescue the Kramers in Alaska by converting an old barn into a commercial fishing kitchen. But when Marty is suddenly forced to quarantine, Matt and Misty must finish alone.
In the wake of Government shutdowns, The Bushmen are forced back into their deadly mine. Dan and Renee's impatience could cost them their lives.
With water running critically low at their only wash dam, The Cheals work to restore a second agitator. Slim Pickings battle a bung wall breach.
Permit delays ruin the Poseidon Crew's hopes of a massive payday on their famed ground. A torrential downpour forces Shane and Russell to evacuate their dig site.
Jacqui and Andrew are targeted by potential gold thieves while Marcus and Linden hunt ground close to the site of the biggest nugget ever found in Western Australia.
When a dam breaks during routine maintenance, engineers fear a catastrophic flood; experts use the latest science to investigate what went wrong and how a simple miscalculation could be to blame.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: Hundreds of cameras capture Hurricane Ida as the Category 4 storm slams the Louisiana coast in 2021, but when the superstorm shifts to the Northeast, eyewitnesses film harrowing encounters with tornadoes and flooding all the way to New York City.

In the aftermath of Japan's 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster, citizens began reporting something truly amazing: UFOs. Phil and Jess enter a radioactive wasteland to discover the stunning truth behind these extraterrestrial encounters.

This crime drama follows former police detective Carrie Wells who has a rare condition that makes her memory flawless. Every place, conversation and moment of happiness and heartbreak is embedded in her mind forever. Beckett races to find a stolen toxin capable of killing thousands of people and Castle has less than 24 hours to live after being exposed to the chemical weapon.

Carrie and Al's first case with the NYPD's Major Crimes Section, a high-profile kidnapping, hits close to home.

Mary and Eleanor attempt to piece together the facts of events from 20-years earlier in attempt to exonerate him. Following the Governor's Ball, Brandi does her best to create a divide in her relationship with Peter.

Matt and Niqué Leili's love story is a modern romance. They meet online, create a blended family and appear to have it all, then their seemingly happy marriage is torn apart forever.

To most people, teenage sweethearts Steven and Michelle Gibson seem to be happily married. They have four children and live a fun and adventurous life together. But the couple is harbouring a dark secret -- one that will tear the family apart.

Byron and Michele Wright overcome broken homes to find solace in one another. But when their blissful union falls apart and a new man arrives on the scene, it unearths violent secrets and a shocking truth.

Young parents Gary and Tasha Bentley are living the good life. They've got high-paying jobs, a nice house, and regular holidays to the tropics, but just five years into their marriage, someone's plotting an exit strategy that ends with a bullet.

p.t: It'll Be Alright on the Night
p.d: Tom Allen celebrates funny cock-ups featuring our favourite TV shows and stars, unseen outtakes, and live broadcast bloopers from our favourite dramas, comedies and entertainment shows - starring Idris Elba, Paul Rudd, Alan Carr, Gemma Collins, Ant and Dec, Susanna Reid, Helen Skelton, the cast of Coronation Street and many more, the cock-ups include Love Island filming being sabotaged by angry geese.
Kim and Sadie have a hostile run-in, Sadie drops a bombshell, and Lewis is upset by an answer.
Kit tries to bury his health fears by throwing himself into work, Shona begins to doubt her own sanity, Summer has another date with Marco, and Debbie lies to Ronnie to cover up her forgetfulness.

Can a celebrity take on and defeat the greatest quiz team in the world? Bradley Walsh hosts as comedian Russell Kane, This Morning's Dr Zoe Williams, broadcaster Kaye Adams, journalist and presenter Matt Allwright and writer and broadcaster Gyles Brandreth take on the Chasers in a bid to win big money for their chosen charities.
Jodie has landed in Bali and Diags is over the moon. Elma says she's happy for them, but seeing them together could be harder than she thought.
Dawson interviews Joey's father about his past for his film final, Mr McPhee plans to take Andie and Jack with him, and Jen wants to leave.
Prue and Phoebe break a code of conduct to cure Piper when she is hospitalised with a deadly disease, but the illness is spread to other patients.

Stephen Mulhern hosts as Ush takes her turn to open the celebrated red boxes - she might open the right boxes in the right order to win herself a fortune or accept a tempting offer from the Banker and leave the game early.
Things get heated in the chilled aisle as the shoppers scramble for Rylan's shopping list.
Graham Norton invites customer experience manager Phil, HR manager Jamie-Lee, and hair salon owner Helen to spin the Wheel, solve puzzles and avoid the bankrupts for a possible 50,000 pounds.
With the gang heading back to Essex, Dan doesn't want the party to end, and so he sets up a group chat inviting his new gang on a big night out to keep the Bali flame alight.
The clock is ticking on Karen's court date as she examines what really caused her accident; Jassi hosts an event for her boyfriend, Darius, after a meeting at the White House.

p.t: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
p.d: The fangs are out at the Viper Room, where tensions are high between Kyle and Dorit; Bozoma navigates the next step in her fertility journey with her man by her side.

Kadeena Cox, Adam James and Ellie Taylor all try to guess the well-known phrases from the animated clues - if they can 'say what they see', they could get the chance to win 50,000 pounds for their chosen charity.
Graham Norton invites operations manager Emma, partnerships manager Ebona, and consultant Dan to spin the Wheel, solve puzzles and play for a chance to win a potential 50,000 pounds.

Have you ever wondered how clever you are? This is your chance to find out as comedy legend Lee Mack presents the ultimate leveller of a quiz show where the questions are all about logic and common sense and where the whole family can play together - 100 contestants begin every show, but only some of them will get near the chance to answer a question that only one per cent of the country can get right for up to 100,000 pounds.

A cast of carefully selected housemates from all walks of life take up residence in the world's most famous reality TV home for up to six weeks, with cameras capturing their every move and the nation following every twist and turn.
Pete's newly acquired enthusiasm for apps inadvertently causes Chris to be labelled a sex offender, and sent on a rehab course.
Brian and Stewie find themselves locked in a safety deposit room for an entire weekend in this special 150th episode.
Morse teams up with Sergeant Lewis to investigate the case of a woman found dead at her home. While all the evidence points to suicide, Morse is convinced he is dealing with a murder.
Merton has to call in CID when armed robbers snatch a woman's diamonds from her neck. Ben shares some unexpected news with Liz while, David basks in his new-found fame.
When an ex-army officer is found dead in his home, suspicion is cast on his money-hungry wife, and Rosie ends up with more admirers than she bargained for when she goes on a blind date.
Sister Brigid has a crisis of faith over a mother whose life is in danger, family secrets are exposed when a hunting trip ends in tragedy, and Ken and Harper clash over the hospital laundry.
Leopard's Den is undergoing its annual inspection, but Danny's efforts to pass are thwarted when he discovers that their waterhole has been drained.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.
Deirdre finally stands up to Peter and refuses to leave Simon with him. Julie fears she might be pregnant, but Kirk is delighted at the prospect, while Tom apologises to Maria.
Deirdre threatens to call social services about Peter's drinking. Dev asks Minnie to pretend to be an art dealer, and Molly's plans irritate Sally.

When a retired policeman is killed while escaping to Spain with a mystery woman, Merton is faced with the task of breaking the news to his widow. Vernon tries to make a quick buck at the poker table but comes a cropper at the hands of a crafty hustler.
A new doctor arrives in Aidensfield, and Merton is put under pressure when Jenny becomes convinced that he is having an affair.

The surgery is chaotic with both Martin and Louisa now practising from it. Bert's new business venture with Al isn't off to a good start and Penhale suspects noise complaints are due to paranormal activity.

Morwenna is back as receptionist and the Ellinghams have a new dog. Martin attends Stewart's survival course, but not as a participant like Al and Penhale. Louisa agrees to help Pippa by speaking at the school assembly alongside Mrs Tishell.

It is 1917 and Downton has been turned into a convalescent home for wounded officers. There is a lot to do, and the arrival of the first patients turns the house upside down. Matthew brings General Sir Herbert Strutt to inspect the home, unaware that Branson is planning to make the visit a memorable one. Meanwhile, Violet hopes to find skeletons in Lavinia's closet.

Dorothy is not impressed as Rachel hides out at Janet's, and even Rachel knows deep down that she will have to face her husband soon. The disturbing story of Joe Bevan continues to unfold as the body count rises and the team faces the task of identifying the victims and Joe's daughter Helen faces a tough time as the press interest mounts, and she begins to realise the true extent of her father's horrific actions.

Following farming contractors up and down the country who are drafted in to help farmers during their busiest times of the year, highlighting the professional challenges they face, their daily routines, and their personal aspirations.

Paul travels by vintage bike through the spectacular scenery of the central Highlands to better appreciate the charms of nature. His adventure starts in Glen Lyon then heads north via Pitlochry and ends in the Cairngorms National Park.

Following a heart transplant and a double amputation, the Purvis family found themselves living apart because their home was not equipped for Kieron's special needs.

Special police task forces tackle a hit-and-run in Lancashire which turns out to be a deliberate attack on a single mum, and they also tackle a drug-dealing family dynasty in Bury.
Paramedics in Portsmouth attend a man with a mechanical heart valve and a dangerously fast pulse, while in Oxford, crews treat a student having an asthma attack.

It's Christmas at Button House, and Mike is determined to make it perfect for his family. Alison is also determined to deliver the best Christmas ever for the living and the dead, although the latter aren't filled with festive cheer. Christmas just isn't that much fun when you're deceased. But when Julian is confronted with past wrongs, he has a revelation that could help the ghosts rediscover the real message of Christmas.

p.d: The homes of Britain are stacked with unwanted possessions. Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien are here to turn them into hard cash for their owners. Some stained glass and a Victorian hay rack are among this programme's finds.
